data.title: Credential Testing After Dump
data.description: Detects rapid credential validation attempts occurring shortly after a credential dump event. After infostealers exfiltrate harvested credentials, threat actors typically run automated validation to identify which stolen credentials are still active, producing a burst of login attempts across multiple banking portals from the attacker's infrastructure.
falsepositives: Corporate SSO gateways performing health checks against multiple accounts
Automated monitoring systems testing service account connectivity
